│                                                                                              │
│                                                                                              │
│  ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗   │
│  ║  STEP 8: What happens when JSESSIONID is missing or expired?                         ║   │
│  ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝   │
│                                                                                              │
│  Scenario A: JSESSIONID cookie not present (new browser, cleared cookies)                   │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                       │
│  Browser → GET /dashboard  (no Cookie header)                                               │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  SecurityContextHolderFilter: No session cookie → empty SecurityContext                      │
│  AuthorizationFilter: Not authenticated → AccessDeniedException                              │
│  ExceptionTranslationFilter: → 302 Redirect to /login                                      │
│  → User must log in again!                                                                   │
│                                                                                              │
│  Scenario B: JSESSIONID exists but session expired (idle > 30 min)                          │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                            │
│  Browser → GET /dashboard                                                                   │
│            Cookie: JSESSIONID=AUTH_SESSION_42                                               │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  Tomcat: SessionManager.findSession("AUTH_SESSION_42")                                      │
│  → Session found BUT lastAccessedTime + maxInactiveInterval < now()                         │
│  → Session EXPIRED → removed from memory → returns null                                     │
│  SecurityContextHolderFilter: No valid session → empty SecurityContext                       │
│  AuthorizationFilter: Not authenticated → AccessDeniedException                              │
│  ExceptionTranslationFilter: → 302 Redirect to /login                                      │
│  → User must log in again!                                                                   │
│                                                                                              │
│  Scenario C: JSESSIONID exists but is tampered/unknown                                      │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────                                       │
│  Browser → GET /dashboard                                                                   │
│            Cookie: JSESSIONID=FAKE_SESSION_999                                              │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  Tomcat: SessionManager.findSession("FAKE_SESSION_999") → NOT FOUND                        │
│  → Same flow as above → 302 Redirect to /login                                             │
│                                                                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>

docs.title: 9.3 Complete Code Example — Form Login with Database Auth
docs.text:
@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final UserAuthEntityService userAuthEntityService;

    public SecurityConfig(UserAuthEntityService userAuthEntityService) {
        this.userAuthEntityService = userAuthEntityService;
    }

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers("/auth/**").permitAll()   // Registration, public pages
                .requestMatchers("/css/**", "/js/**").permitAll()  // Static resources
                .anyRequest().authenticated()               // Everything else needs login
            )

            // ─── Form Login Configuration ────────────────────────────────────
            .formLogin(form -> form
                .loginPage("/login")                    // Custom login page URL (GET)
                .loginProcessingUrl("/login")           // Form action URL (POST)
                .defaultSuccessUrl("/dashboard", false) // Redirect after login
                // false = redirect to originally requested URL if available
                // true  = always redirect to /dashboard
                .failureUrl("/login?error=true")        // Redirect on failure
                .usernameParameter("username")          // HTML form field name (default)
                .passwordParameter("password")          // HTML form field name (default)
                .permitAll()                            // Allow everyone to see login page
            )

            // ─── Logout Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────
            .logout(logout -> logout
                .logoutUrl("/logout")                   // URL to trigger logout (POST)
                .logoutSuccessUrl("/login?logout=true") // Redirect after logout
                .invalidateHttpSession(true)            // Destroy session
                .deleteCookies("JSESSIONID")            // Remove session cookie
                .clearAuthentication(true)              // Clear SecurityContext
                .permitAll()
            )

            // ─── Session Management ──────────────────────────────────────────
            .sessionManagement(session -> session
                .sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.IF_REQUIRED) // Default
                .maximumSessions(1)                    // Only 1 session per user
                .expiredUrl("/login?expired=true")     // Redirect if session expires
            );

        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12);
    }

    @Bean
    public AuthenticationProvider authenticationProvider() {
        DaoAuthenticationProvider provider = new DaoAuthenticationProvider();
        provider.setUserDetailsService(userAuthEntityService);
        provider.setPasswordEncoder(passwordEncoder());
        return provider;
    }
}

Custom Login Page (Thymeleaf example — /templates/login.html):

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org">
<head>
    <title>Login</title>
</head>
<body>
    <h2>Login</h2>

    <!-- Show error message if login failed -->
    <div th:if="${param.error}" style="color: red;">
        Invalid username or password.
    </div>

    <!-- Show logout message -->
    <div th:if="${param.logout}" style="color: green;">
        You have been logged out.
    </div>

    <!-- Login Form -->
    <!-- action="/login" matches .loginProcessingUrl("/login") in SecurityConfig -->
    <!-- method="POST" is required — GET /login shows the page, POST /login submits -->
    <form th:action="@{/login}" method="POST">

        <label>Username:</label>
        <input type="text" name="username" required />
        <!-- name="username" must match .usernameParameter("username") -->

        <label>Password:</label>
        <input type="password" name="password" required />
        <!-- name="password" must match .passwordParameter("password") -->

        <!-- CSRF token is automatically injected by Thymeleaf + Spring Security -->
        <!-- Renders as: <input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="abc123..."/> -->

        <button type="submit">Sign In</button>
    </form>

    <a href="/auth/register">Register</a>
</body>
</html>

Logout Form (in any authenticated page):

<!-- Logout MUST be a POST request (GET logout is disabled by default for CSRF safety) -->
<form th:action="@{/logout}" method="POST">
    <button type="submit">Logout</button>
</form>

docs.title: 9.4 Request / Response Headers — What Actually Travels Over the Network
docs.text:
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ACTUAL HTTP HEADERS — WHAT THE BROWSER AND SERVER EXCHANGE                                  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                              │
│  ── REQUEST 1: Access protected page (no cookie yet) ─────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  GET /dashboard HTTP/1.1                                                                    │
│  Host: localhost:8080                                                                        │
│  Accept: text/html                                                                           │
│  (no Cookie header)                                                                          │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── RESPONSE 1: Redirect to login ────────────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  HTTP/1.1 302 Found                                                                          │
│  Location: http://localhost:8080/login                                                       │
│  Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=A1B2C3D4E5F6; Path=/; HttpOnly                                    │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── REQUEST 2: Submit credentials ────────────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  POST /login HTTP/1.1                                                                        │
│  Host: localhost:8080                                                                        │
│  Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded                                            │
│  Cookie: JSESSIONID=A1B2C3D4E5F6                                                           │
│                                                                                              │
│  username=john&password=john123&_csrf=x9y8z7-w6v5-u4t3-s2r1-q0p9o8n7m6l5                  │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── RESPONSE 2: Login success — NEW session ID (session fixation protection) ──             │
│                                                                                              │
│  HTTP/1.1 302 Found                                                                          │
│  Location: http://localhost:8080/dashboard                                                   │
│  Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=X7Y8Z9W0V1U2; Path=/; HttpOnly                                    │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────                                      │
│  ↑ NEW session ID! Old A1B2C3D4E5F6 is invalidated.                                        │
│    This prevents session fixation attacks.                                                   │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── REQUEST 3: Access dashboard (with new session cookie) ────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  GET /dashboard HTTP/1.1                                                                    │
│  Host: localhost:8080                                                                        │
│  Cookie: JSESSIONID=X7Y8Z9W0V1U2     ← Browser auto-sends new cookie                     │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── RESPONSE 3: Dashboard content ────────────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  HTTP/1.1 200 OK                                                                             │
│  Content-Type: text/html                                                                    │
│  (Dashboard HTML)                                                                            │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── REQUEST 4+: Any subsequent request ───────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  GET /api/orders HTTP/1.1                                                                    │
│  Cookie: JSESSIONID=X7Y8Z9W0V1U2     ← Same cookie, no credentials needed                 │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── LOGOUT REQUEST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  POST /logout HTTP/1.1                                                                       │
│  Cookie: JSESSIONID=X7Y8Z9W0V1U2                                                           │
│  Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded                                            │
│  _csrf=x9y8z7-w6v5-u4t3-s2r1-q0p9o8n7m6l5                                                │
│                                                                                              │
│  ── LOGOUT RESPONSE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────              │
│                                                                                              │
│  HTTP/1.1 302 Found                                                                          │
│  Location: http://localhost:8080/login?logout                                                │
│  Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0                                      │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────                                          │
│  ↑ Max-Age=0 tells the browser to DELETE the cookie immediately.                            │
│    Session X7Y8Z9W0V1U2 is invalidated on the server.                                      │
│                                                                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 9.5 Internal Filter Chain — Which Filter Does What
docs.text:
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FILTERS INVOLVED IN FORM LOGIN (in order of execution)                                      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                              │
│  Request arrives                                                                             │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 1. SecurityContextHolderFilter                                                      │    │
│  │    • Loads SecurityContext from HttpSession (via JSESSIONID cookie)                  │    │
│  │    • If session exists → user is already authenticated (no re-login)               │    │
│  │    • If no session → SecurityContext is empty (anonymous)                           │    │
│  │    • After request completes: saves SecurityContext back to session                 │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 2. CsrfFilter                                                                       │    │
│  │    • For POST requests: validates _csrf token from form matches session's token     │    │
│  │    • Prevents CSRF attacks (malicious sites can't forge valid forms)                │    │
│  │    • GET requests: generates and stores CSRF token in session                       │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 3. UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter                                              │    │
│  │    • ONLY activates for: POST /login                                                │    │
│  │    • Extracts username + password from form data                                    │    │
│  │    • Creates UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken                                    │    │
│  │    • Calls AuthenticationManager.authenticate()                                      │    │
│  │    • On success: saves auth in SecurityContext, redirects to success URL            │    │
│  │    • On failure: redirects to /login?error                                          │    │
│  │    • For ALL OTHER requests: does nothing, passes to next filter                    │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 4. DefaultLoginPageGeneratingFilter                                                  │    │
│  │    • Intercepts GET /login (only if no custom login page is configured)             │    │
│  │    • Generates auto HTML login form with CSRF token                                 │    │
│  │    • If custom .loginPage("/login") with Thymeleaf → this filter is NOT registered │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 5. DefaultLogoutPageGeneratingFilter                                                 │    │
│  │    • Intercepts GET /logout                                                          │    │
│  │    • Generates auto HTML "Are you sure you want to log out?" page                   │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 6. LogoutFilter                                                                      │    │
│  │    • Activates for: POST /logout                                                    │    │
│  │    • Invalidates HttpSession                                                         │    │
│  │    • Clears SecurityContextHolder                                                    │    │
│  │    • Deletes JSESSIONID cookie (Set-Cookie: Max-Age=0)                              │    │
│  │    • Redirects to /login?logout                                                     │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 7. RequestCacheAwareFilter                                                           │    │
│  │    • After login success: retrieves the original URL from requestCache              │    │
│  │    • Replays the original request (e.g., redirect to /dashboard)                    │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 8. AuthorizationFilter                                                               │    │
│  │    • Checks if current user (from SecurityContext) has access to the URL            │    │
│  │    • Evaluates: .requestMatchers(...).hasRole(...) rules                            │    │
│  │    • Allowed → proceed to controller                                                │    │
│  │    • Denied → throws AccessDeniedException                                          │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ 9. ExceptionTranslationFilter                                                        │    │
│  │    • Catches AccessDeniedException and AuthenticationException                      │    │
│  │    • If user not authenticated: saves original URL → redirect to /login             │    │
│  │    • If user authenticated but no permission: → 403 Forbidden                      │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│       │                                                                                      │
│       ▼                                                                                      │
│  Controller handles the request                                                              │
│                                                                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 9.6 Session Timeout & Configuration
docs.text:
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SESSION TIMEOUT — HOW IT WORKS                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                              │
│  Default: 30 minutes of INACTIVITY (not 30 minutes from login!)                             │
│                                                                                              │
│  How Tomcat calculates timeout:                                                              │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐           │
│  │  if (currentTime - session.lastAccessedTime > session.maxInactiveInterval)   │           │
│  │  → Session is EXPIRED → remove from memory                                   │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  Every request that carries JSESSIONID updates lastAccessedTime.             │           │
│  │  So the 30-minute timer RESETS with every request.                            │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  Example:                                                                     │           │
│  │  10:00 → Login (session created, lastAccessed = 10:00)                       │           │
│  │  10:15 → GET /orders (lastAccessed updated to 10:15)                         │           │
│  │  10:25 → GET /profile (lastAccessed updated to 10:25)                        │           │
│  │  10:40 → No request (idle)                                                    │           │
│  │  10:55 → Tomcat checks: 10:55 - 10:25 = 30 min → EXPIRED! Session removed.  │           │
│  │  10:56 → GET /orders → No session → Redirect to /login                      │           │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘           │
│                                                                                              │
│  Configuring timeout in application.properties:                                              │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐           │
│  │  # 30 minutes (default)                                                      │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.timeout=30m                                           │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  # 1 hour                                                                     │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.timeout=60m                                           │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  # 15 minutes                                                                 │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.timeout=15m                                           │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  # In seconds (900 seconds = 15 minutes)                                     │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.timeout=900                                           │           │
│  │                                                                               │           │
│  │  NOTE: Tomcat's minimum is 1 minute. Values below 1m are rounded up to 1m.  │           │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘           │
│                                                                                              │
│  Configuring cookie properties:                                                              │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.cookie.name=JSESSIONID     # Cookie name            │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true       # JS can't access       │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=true          # HTTPS only            │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=Lax        # CSRF protection       │           │
│  │  server.servlet.session.cookie.max-age=-1           # -1 = browser session  │           │
│  │  # max-age=-1 means cookie is deleted when browser closes (session cookie)  │           │
│  │  # Set a positive value for "Remember Me" style persistent cookies          │           │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘           │
│                                                                                              │
│  Configuring session management in Java:                                                     │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐           │
│  │  .sessionManagement(session -> session                                       │           │
│  │      .sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.IF_REQUIRED)  // default  │           │
│  │      .invalidSessionUrl("/login?invalid")           // invalid session ID   │           │
│  │      .sessionFixation().migrateSession()            // default: migrate     │           │
│  │      .maximumSessions(1)                             // 1 session per user  │           │
│  │      .maxSessionsPreventsLogin(false)                // kick old session    │           │
│  │      // false = new login kicks old session (default)                       │           │
│  │      // true  = new login is DENIED if session already exists               │           │
│  │  )                                                                           │           │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘           │
│                                                                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

│    │<─────────────────────────────────────────│                                              │
│    │                                          │                                              │
│    │  ... (user idle for 30+ minutes) ...     │                                              │
│    │                                          │ Tomcat background thread:                     │
│    │                                          │ Session #2 expired! Removed from memory.     │
│    │                                          │                                              │
│    │  GET /api/orders                         │                                              │
│    │  Cookie: JSESSIONID=#2                   │                                              │
│    │─────────────────────────────────────────>│ Session #2 NOT FOUND (expired)               │
│    │                                          │ SecurityContext: empty → not authenticated   │
│    │  302 Redirect /login                     │ AuthorizationFilter: denied                  │
│    │<─────────────────────────────────────────│ → Redirect to login                          │
│    │                                          │                                              │
│    │  ... (user logs in again, same flow) ... │                                              │
│    │                                          │                                              │
│    │  POST /logout                            │                                              │
│    │  Cookie: JSESSIONID=#3                   │                                              │
│    │─────────────────────────────────────────>│ LogoutFilter:                                │
│    │                                          │   session.invalidate() → removed             │
│    │                                          │   SecurityContextHolder.clearContext()        │
│    │  302 Redirect /login?logout              │   delete JSESSIONID cookie                   │
│    │  Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=; Max-Age=0      │   redirect to /login?logout                  │
│    │<─────────────────────────────────────────│                                              │
│    │                                          │                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 9.8 Key Takeaways — Form Login Flow Summary
docs.text:
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FORM LOGIN — KEY FACTS SUMMARY                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                              │
│  1. AUTHENTICATION HAPPENS ONCE:                                                            │
│     User provides username + password ONLY at POST /login.                                  │
│     After that, JSESSIONID cookie handles everything.                                       │
│                                                                                              │
│  2. SESSION = SERVER-SIDE STATE:                                                            │
│     Server stores SecurityContext (user info + roles) in HttpSession.                       │
│     Session lives in Tomcat's ConcurrentHashMap (JVM memory).                               │
│     This is WHY it's called STATEFUL authentication.                                        │
│                                                                                              │
│  3. JSESSIONID = OPAQUE POINTER:                                                            │
│     The cookie value is a random string — no user data inside.                              │
│     It's just a KEY to look up the session on the server.                                   │
│     Unlike JWT, it cannot be decoded or inspected by the client.                            │
│                                                                                              │
│  4. BROWSER AUTO-SENDS COOKIE:                                                              │
│     Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=ABC → browser stores it.                                        │
│     Every subsequent request to the same domain → Cookie: JSESSIONID=ABC.                  │
│     Zero client-side JavaScript needed.                                                     │
│                                                                                              │
│  5. SESSION FIXATION PROTECTION:                                                            │
│     Spring Security generates a NEW session ID after successful login.                      │
│     Old session ID is invalidated. Prevents attackers from pre-setting a session.           │
│                                                                                              │
│  6. TIMEOUT = INACTIVITY BASED:                                                             │
│     Default: 30 minutes of NO requests.                                                     │
│     Every request resets the timer.                                                         │
│     After timeout → session deleted → user must log in again.                               │
│                                                                                              │
│  7. NO JSESSIONID = REDIRECT TO LOGIN:                                                      │
│     If the cookie is missing, expired, or invalid:                                          │
│     → SecurityContext is empty → not authenticated                                          │
│     → AuthorizationFilter denies access                                                     │
│     → ExceptionTranslationFilter redirects to /login                                       │
│                                                                                              │
│  8. IT IS THE DEFAULT IN SPRING SECURITY:                                                   │
│     When you add spring-boot-starter-security + .formLogin():                               │
│     → Auto-generates login/logout pages                                                     │
│     → Creates sessions automatically                                                        │
│     → SessionCreationPolicy.IF_REQUIRED (default)                                           │
│     → No JWT, no OAuth2, no extra config needed                                             │
│                                                                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

10.1 Customizing Default Login/Logout URLs, Session Timeout & Form Login UI
docs.text:
The Problem: Spring Security's defaults (auto-generated login page, /login URL, 30-minute timeout) are fine for prototyping but every production app needs custom branding, custom URLs, and configured session timeouts.

│  │  Login Success URL       │  / or saved request      │  .defaultSuccessUrl()            │  │

docs.title: 10.1.1 Complete SecurityConfig — All Customizations in One Place
docs.text:
@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final UserAuthEntityService userAuthEntityService;

    public SecurityConfig(UserAuthEntityService userAuthEntityService) {
        this.userAuthEntityService = userAuthEntityService;
    }

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
            // ─── URL Authorization Rules ─────────────────────────────────────
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers(
                    "/auth/**",           // Registration, public endpoints
                    "/custom-login",      // Custom login page (GET) must be permitAll!
                    "/css/**",            // Static CSS files
                    "/js/**",             // Static JS files
                    "/images/**",         // Static images
                    "/error"              // Error page
                ).permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
                .requestMatchers("/api/**").hasAnyRole("USER", "ADMIN")
                .anyRequest().authenticated()
            )

            // ─── Custom Form Login ───────────────────────────────────────────
            .formLogin(form -> form

                // ① Custom Login Page URL (GET request to show the login form)
                // DEFAULT: /login (auto-generated by DefaultLoginPageGeneratingFilter)
                // CUSTOM:  /custom-login → YOUR Thymeleaf/JSP template
                .loginPage("/custom-login")
                // IMPORTANT: When you set a custom loginPage():
                //   - DefaultLoginPageGeneratingFilter is NOT registered
                //   - DefaultLogoutPageGeneratingFilter is NOT registered
                //   - You MUST create a controller that handles GET /custom-login
                //   - You MUST add "/custom-login" to permitAll() or everyone gets 403!

                // ② Custom Login Processing URL (POST request that submits credentials)
                // DEFAULT: /login
                // This is the URL your HTML form's action attribute points to
                // UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter intercepts THIS URL
                .loginProcessingUrl("/perform-login")
                // Your HTML form: <form method="POST" action="/perform-login">

                // ③ Custom Form Field Names
                // DEFAULT: "username" and "password"
                // If your HTML form uses different input names:
                .usernameParameter("email")        // <input name="email" />
                .passwordParameter("passwd")       // <input name="passwd" />

                // ④ Success URL after login
                // DEFAULT: redirects to the originally requested URL (saved in requestCache)
                .defaultSuccessUrl("/dashboard", false)
                // false = redirect to saved request URL if it exists, else /dashboard
                // true  = ALWAYS redirect to /dashboard (ignore saved request)

                // ⑤ Failure URL when login fails
                // DEFAULT: /login?error
                .failureUrl("/custom-login?error=true")

                // ⑥ Custom Success Handler (advanced — overrides defaultSuccessUrl)
                // .successHandler((request, response, authentication) -> {
                //     // Custom logic: log login event, redirect based on role, etc.
                //     if (authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                //             .anyMatch(a -> a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_ADMIN"))) {
                //         response.sendRedirect("/admin/dashboard");
                //     } else {
                //         response.sendRedirect("/user/dashboard");
                //     }
                // })

                // ⑦ Custom Failure Handler (advanced — overrides failureUrl)
                // .failureHandler((request, response, exception) -> {
                //     String errorMessage = "Invalid credentials";
                //     if (exception instanceof LockedException) {
                //         errorMessage = "Account is locked";
                //     } else if (exception instanceof DisabledException) {
                //         errorMessage = "Account is disabled";
                //     }
                //     request.getSession().setAttribute("error", errorMessage);
                //     response.sendRedirect("/custom-login?error=true");
                // })

                // Allow everyone to access the login page and processing URL
                .permitAll()
            )

            // ─── Custom Logout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
            .logout(logout -> logout

                // ① Custom Logout URL (POST request to trigger logout)
                // DEFAULT: /logout
                .logoutUrl("/perform-logout")
                // Your HTML form: <form method="POST" action="/perform-logout">

                // ② Custom Logout Success URL
                // DEFAULT: /login?logout
                .logoutSuccessUrl("/custom-login?logout=true")

                // ③ Invalidate session on logout
                // DEFAULT: true
                .invalidateHttpSession(true)

                // ④ Delete cookies on logout
                .deleteCookies("JSESSIONID", "remember-me")

                // ⑤ Clear the SecurityContext
                // DEFAULT: true
                .clearAuthentication(true)

                // ⑥ Custom Logout Success Handler (advanced — overrides logoutSuccessUrl)
                // .logoutSuccessHandler((request, response, authentication) -> {
                //     // Log logout event, redirect to external page, etc.
                //     response.sendRedirect("/custom-login?logout=true");
                // })

                .permitAll()
            )

            // ─── Session Management ──────────────────────────────────────────
            .sessionManagement(session -> session
                .sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.IF_REQUIRED)
                .invalidSessionUrl("/custom-login?expired=true")
                .sessionFixation().migrateSession()      // Default: migrate session
                .maximumSessions(1)                       // Only 1 session per user
                .expiredUrl("/custom-login?expired=true") // Redirect when session expires
                .maxSessionsPreventsLogin(false)          // false = kick old session
            );

        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12);
    }

    @Bean
    public AuthenticationProvider authenticationProvider() {
        DaoAuthenticationProvider provider = new DaoAuthenticationProvider();
        provider.setUserDetailsService(userAuthEntityService);
        provider.setPasswordEncoder(passwordEncoder());
        return provider;
    }
}

docs.title: 10.1.2 Custom Login Page Controller
docs.text:
@Controller
public class LoginController {

    // This handles GET /custom-login → shows the login form
    // Spring Security's UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter handles POST /perform-login
    @GetMapping("/custom-login")
    public String showLoginPage(
            @RequestParam(value = "error", required = false) String error,
            @RequestParam(value = "logout", required = false) String logout,
            @RequestParam(value = "expired", required = false) String expired,
            Model model) {

        if (error != null) {
            model.addAttribute("errorMessage", "Invalid email or password. Please try again.");
        }
        if (logout != null) {
            model.addAttribute("logoutMessage", "You have been logged out successfully.");
        }
        if (expired != null) {
            model.addAttribute("expiredMessage", "Your session has expired. Please login again.");
        }

        return "login";  // → templates/login.html (Thymeleaf)
    }
}

docs.title: 10.1.3 Custom Login Page — Thymeleaf Template (templates/login.html)
docs.text:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Login - My Application</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" th:href="@{/css/login.css}" />
</head>
<body>

<div class="login-container">

    <div class="login-card">
        <div class="logo">
            <img th:src="@{/images/logo.png}" alt="Logo" />
        </div>

        <h2>Welcome Back</h2>
        <p class="subtitle">Sign in to your account</p>

        <!-- ─── Error Messages ─────────────────────────────────────── -->
        <div th:if="${errorMessage}" class="alert alert-error">
            <span th:text="${errorMessage}">Error</span>
        </div>

        <div th:if="${logoutMessage}" class="alert alert-success">
            <span th:text="${logoutMessage}">Logged out</span>
        </div>

        <div th:if="${expiredMessage}" class="alert alert-warning">
            <span th:text="${expiredMessage}">Session expired</span>
        </div>

        <!-- ─── Login Form ─────────────────────────────────────────── -->
        <!--
            CRITICAL POINTS:
            1. action="/perform-login" must match .loginProcessingUrl("/perform-login")
            2. method="POST" is required (GET won't work)
            3. name="email" must match .usernameParameter("email")
            4. name="passwd" must match .passwordParameter("passwd")
            5. CSRF token is auto-injected by Thymeleaf (th:action)
        -->
        <form th:action="@{/perform-login}" method="POST">

            <div class="form-group">
                <label for="email">Email Address</label>
                <input type="email"
                       id="email"
                       name="email"
                       placeholder="john@example.com"
                       required
                       autofocus />
                <!-- name="email" matches .usernameParameter("email") in SecurityConfig -->
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label for="passwd">Password</label>
                <input type="password"
                       id="passwd"
                       name="passwd"
                       placeholder="Enter your password"
                       required />
                <!-- name="passwd" matches .passwordParameter("passwd") in SecurityConfig -->
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="btn-login">Sign In</button>

            <!--
                The CSRF hidden field is AUTOMATICALLY added by Thymeleaf
                when you use th:action. It renders as:
                <input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="uuid-token-here"/>
            -->
        </form>

        <div class="footer-links">
            <a href="/auth/register">Create an account</a>
            <a href="/auth/forgot-password">Forgot password?</a>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

</body>
</html>

Custom Logout Button (in any authenticated page like dashboard.html):

<!-- Logout form — action must match .logoutUrl("/perform-logout") -->
<form th:action="@{/perform-logout}" method="POST" style="display: inline;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn-logout">Logout</button>
</form>

docs.title: 10.1.4 Session Timeout Configuration (application.properties)
docs.text:
# ─── Session Timeout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DEFAULT: 30m (Tomcat default)
# This is INACTIVITY timeout — timer resets with every request
server.servlet.session.timeout=45m

# ─── Session Cookie Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
server.servlet.session.cookie.name=JSESSIONID       # Cookie name (default)
server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true         # Prevent JavaScript access (XSS protection)
server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=true            # Only send over HTTPS
server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=Lax          # CSRF protection (Lax or Strict)
server.servlet.session.cookie.max-age=-1             # -1 = session cookie (deleted when browser closes)
server.servlet.session.cookie.path=/                 # Cookie valid for entire app

# ─── Tomcat-Specific Session Settings ─────────────────────────────────────────
server.servlet.session.tracking-modes=cookie         # Only use cookies (not URL rewriting)
# URL rewriting appends ;jsessionid=ABC to URLs — SECURITY RISK! Always disable it.
